CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content found.

COD.rationale: Content (red) and its presentation/organization are listed and an origin/status field is provided for the same n0/current item; scope of status vs display is ambiguous.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the identified contents' presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries name color (red/blue) sets with coordinate lists.

D.rationale: Content coordinate lists are presented alongside explicit origin/status metadata for the same n0/current items, distinguishing identification from provenance/access status.

O.rationale: The report states spatial orientation and gives explicit presentations/arrangements of the content (coordinate lists) under current time.
